page.layout: One page: a table of Greek verb forms in three columns, with a row label at the far left. Centred sub-headings sit between the blocks. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.
page.notes: The Greek forms are copied from a small printed table and are partly uncertain, notably the aspirated and prefixed forms in the Perfectum and Infinitive rows, where the ink is faint and smudged by a brown stain near the second Perfectum row. Row labels in the left column are Latin abbreviations, transcribed as printed. No marginal notes or catchword are visible.
